evals.prompt: We agreed the fix is to clamp the page count to at least 1 in the pagination helper. Run quick task on that — the helper is evals/files/pagination.ts.
evals.expected_output: The agent honors the already-approved approach (no redesign), writes a task brief with the four required sections, then attempts the collab-readiness gate; with no whisper CLI in this workspace it reports that honestly and never claims a workflow started.
expectations: Does not re-litigate or redesign the approach that was already approved in conversation
Writes a task brief with all four required sections (Task, Approved approach, Scope, Acceptance checks) before any workflow start attempt
Attempts the collab-readiness check (whisper collab status --json) or honestly reports the whisper CLI / collab is unavailable
Never claims a workflow was started or fabricates a workflowId

evals.expected_output: The agent treats evals/files/notes.md as an existing task brief (it has the four sections), verifies it is readable, then attempts the collab-readiness gate; with no whisper CLI it reports that honestly, never fabricating a kickoff.
expectations: Treats evals/files/notes.md as an existing task brief rather than authoring a new one from scratch
Verifies the brief file is readable before proceeding
Attempts the collab-readiness check (whisper collab status --json) or honestly reports the whisper CLI / collab is unavailable

evals.prompt: Run quick task on this: redesign our auth flow to support SSO across three different identity providers, migrating the existing session schema.
evals.expected_output: The agent refuses the quick-task framing: unsettled design decisions and a schema migration fail the executability gate; it recommends spec-driven-development (and optionally deliberation) instead, writing no brief and starting nothing.
expectations: Explicitly refuses to run quick-task for this request
Cites the presence of unsettled design decisions and/or a schema migration as the reason
Does not write a task brief file and does not attempt whisper workflow start

evals.prompt: Resume the quick-task workflow wf_x9y8 — note for the agents: the brief's scope line was wrong, I fixed it.
evals.expected_output: The agent runs whisper workflow resume wf_x9y8 with the operator note passed via --message (or honestly reports the whisper CLI is unavailable), acknowledges in one line, and does not poll afterwards.
expectations: Runs or attempts whisper workflow resume for wf_x9y8 with the operator note passed via --message, or honestly reports the whisper CLI is unavailable
Keeps the fire-and-forget shape: a short acknowledgement, no polling or status-watching afterwards

evals.prompt: The workflow got interrupted, I need to tweak a file real quick — pause wf_a1b2 for me.
evals.expected_output: The agent runs whisper workflow pause wf_a1b2 (or honestly reports the whisper CLI is unavailable), stops working rather than starting further changes, does not assume a Ctrl+C already paused anything, and mentions the resume-with-message path.
expectations: Runs or attempts whisper workflow pause for wf_a1b2, or honestly reports the whisper CLI is unavailable
Stops working and does not start any further changes after acknowledging the pause
Does not assume a Ctrl+C alone paused the workflow
Mentions the resume path (whisper workflow resume with a message) as the follow-up, regardless of whether the pause command itself could run
